bills.title: AI Worker Data for Job Automation Training Prohibition
bills.summary: Would prohibit collecting or sharing worker data for training AI systems that automate or replace jobs.
bills.status_detail: Introduced by Asm. Ward (D)

bills.title: AI in Clinical Decision-Making Health Privacy Expansion
bills.summary: Would expand California's existing health privacy laws to cover AI and restrict the use of AI in clinical decision making.
bills.status_detail: Introduced by Asm. Bonta (D)

bills.title: Wearable Device Recording Prohibition in Business Settings
bills.summary: Would prohibit unauthorized recording with wearable devices in business settings and require visible recording indicators.
bills.status_detail: Introduced by Sen. Reyes (D)

bills.title: Surveillance Data Pricing Prohibition
bills.summary: Would prohibit the use of surveillance data to set individualized prices or wages.
bills.status_detail: Passed committee; heads for House floor

bills.title: Connecticut Omnibus AI Regulation Bill
bills.summary: Omnibus AI bill covering chatbots, employment, generative AI, automated decision-making tools (ADMT), frontier AI, and more. Would implement transparency and anti-bias measures in automated employment-related decisions; require AI companion providers to include harmful content detection protocols and restrict minors' interactions; and require AI-generated content to be clearly marked and detectable.
bills.status_detail: Passed out of committee with substitute

bills.title: State Agency Automated Decision System Restrictions
bills.summary: Would prohibit state agencies and their contractors from using any automated decision system (ADS) in functions related to public assistance benefits or those that materially impact individual rights, civil liberties, safety, or welfare, unless there is continuous meaningful human review. Would also prohibit procurement of any ADS that would negatively affect existing employee rights, collective bargaining agreements, and employment conditions.
bills.status_detail: Introduced by Rep. Briel

bills.title: AI Developer Safety, Transparency, and Disclosure Requirements
bills.summary: Would establish new safety, transparency, and disclosure requirements for AI developers, including published safety protocols, annual reviews, and incident disclosures. Includes a private right of action.
bills.status_detail: Introduced by Sen. Quade (D)

bills.title: AI Employment Discrimination Prohibition
bills.summary: Would prohibit employers from using AI in employment decisions in ways that result in discrimination and requires employers to notify individuals when AI is used in such processes.
bills.status_detail: Introduced by Sen. Quade (D)

bills.title: AI Mental Health Professional Advertising Prohibition
bills.summary: Would prohibit AI developers and deployers from advertising AI as a mental health professional.
bills.status_detail: Passed committee

bills.title: AI Mental Health Professional Advertising Prohibition (Companion Bill)
bills.summary: Would prohibit AI developers and deployers from advertising AI as a mental health professional.
bills.status_detail: Passed committee

bills.title: Right to Compute Act
bills.summary: Would establish a right to compute, similar to enacted Montana SB 212.
bills.status_detail: Passed first chamber

bills.title: AI Mental Health Services Licensing Requirement
bills.summary: Would prohibit the use of AI to deliver any mental health service that requires a professional license unless the service is provided by a licensed practitioner.
bills.status_detail: Passed first chamber

bills.title: Companion Chatbot Three-Hour Disclosure Notification Requirement
bills.summary: Would require companion chatbot providers to provide three-hour human disclosure notifications to users. Unlike the majority of other chatbot bills, this bill only sets a disclosure requirement with no safety protocol or minor-specific requirements.
bills.status_detail: Passed committee

bills.title: GenAI Regulated Profession Advertising Prohibition
bills.summary: Would prohibit advertising generative AI as capable of practicing regulated professions.
bills.status_detail: Passed committee

bills.title: AI Consumer Interaction Notification Requirement
bills.summary: Would require clear notification to consumers when they are interacting with AI in commercial contexts.
bills.status_detail: Passed committee

bills.title: AI Chatbot Child Sexual Content Criminalization
bills.summary: Would make it a crime to offer, sell, or distribute AI or automated interactive computer technology capable of performing or simulating sexual conduct directed at children. Includes an exception for AI technology with safety features designed to prevent a chatbot from simulating sexual conduct when it detects that a user is a child.
bills.status_detail: Passed committee

bills.title: Personalized Algorithmic Pricing for Groceries Prohibition
bills.summary: Would make it unlawful to use personalized algorithmic pricing or surveillance pricing based on personal data to set the price of groceries or food, with exceptions for bona fide discounts.
bills.status_detail: Passed committee

bills.title: AI Companion Chatbot Minor Safety Safeguards
bills.summary: Would establish new safeguards for minors interacting with AI companion chatbots, including disclosures that users are interacting with AI, recurring three-hour notifications and break prompts, safeguards against sexually explicit content for minors, and a required safety protocol with crisis service provider referrals.
bills.status_detail: Passed Senate; heads to House

bills.title: AI Mental Health Professional Advertising Prohibition
bills.summary: Would prohibit the development or deployment of an AI system that advertises that it is able to act as a qualified mental health professional.
bills.status_detail: Passed both chambers; awaiting Governor's signature

bills.title: Vermont AI Health Services Bill
bills.summary: Vermont AI health services bill modeled on Illinois HB 1806.
bills.status_detail: Passed committee

bills.title: California Chatbot Regulation Bill
bills.summary: California chatbot bill with hearing scheduled April 6 in Senate Privacy, Digital Technologies, and Consumer Protection Committee.
bills.status_detail: Hearing scheduled April 6 in Senate Privacy, Digital Technologies, and Consumer Protection Committee

bills.title: California Generative AI Regulation Bill
bills.summary: California generative AI bill with hearing scheduled April 6 in Senate Privacy, Digital Technologies, and Consumer Protection Committee.
bills.status_detail: Hearing scheduled April 6 in Senate Privacy, Digital Technologies, and Consumer Protection Committee

bills.title: California AI Health Bill
bills.summary: California AI health bill with hearing scheduled April 6 in Senate Privacy, Digital Technologies, and Consumer Protection Committee.
bills.status_detail: Hearing scheduled April 6 in Senate Privacy, Digital Technologies, and Consumer Protection Committee

bills.title: Illinois Generative AI Regulation Bill
bills.summary: Illinois generative AI bill with hearing scheduled March 20 in House Cybersecurity Committee.
bills.status_detail: Hearing scheduled March 20 in House Cybersecurity Committee

bills.title: Missouri Chatbot Regulation Bill
bills.summary: Missouri chatbot bill with hearing scheduled March 23 in House Emerging Issues Committee.
bills.status_detail: Hearing scheduled March 23 in House Emerging Issues Committee

bills.title: National AI Framework Discussion Draft (Blackburn)
bills.summary: Discussion draft released by Sen. Marsha Blackburn (R-TN) to establish a national AI framework, incorporating multiple previously introduced federal bills and codifying elements of President Trump's executive order on artificial intelligence. The proposal does not preempt generally applicable law or include broad preemptions of state AI laws.
bills.status_detail: Discussion draft released by Sen. Blackburn (R-TN) on March 18, 2026

bills.title: AI Job Impacts Quarterly Reporting Requirement
bills.summary: Would require certain companies and federal agencies to report quarterly to the Department of Labor on AI-related job impacts, including layoffs and job displacement. Includes an enforcement mechanism allowing the Secretary of Labor and private parties to bring civil actions for violations. Incorporated into the TRUMP AMERICA AI Act discussion draft.
bills.status_detail: Incorporated into TRUMP AMERICA AI Act discussion draft

bills.title: Kids Online Safety Act
bills.summary: Would require covered online platforms to implement tools and safeguards to protect users under 17 from online harms. Incorporated into the TRUMP AMERICA AI Act discussion draft.
bills.status_detail: Incorporated into TRUMP AMERICA AI Act discussion draft

bills.title: AI Companion Chatbot Minor Safety and Age Verification
bills.summary: Would require AI companies to implement a reasonable age verification process, ban AI companion chatbots for minors, and mandate disclosures that users are interacting with AI at conversation start and at 30-minute intervals, with disclaimers that the system is not a substitute for professional advice. Would establish criminal penalties for companies whose AI companions encourage suicide or solicit sexually explicit conduct from minors. Grants enforcement authority to the Attorney General and state AGs. Incorporated into the TRUMP AMERICA AI Act discussion draft.
bills.status_detail: Incorporated into TRUMP AMERICA AI Act discussion draft

bills.title: DOE Frontier AI Risk Evaluation Program
bills.summary: Would direct the Department of Energy (DOE) to establish an Advanced AI Evaluation Program to assess risks from frontier AI systems above a compute threshold (10^26 FLOPs), requiring developers to participate and provide information to DOE upon request. Would prohibit deployment of covered systems until developers comply. Incorporated into the TRUMP AMERICA AI Act discussion draft.
bills.status_detail: Incorporated into TRUMP AMERICA AI Act discussion draft

bills.title: AI Products Liability Federal Cause of Action
bills.summary: Would classify AI systems as products and create a federal cause of action for products liability claims against AI system developers, covering defective design, failure to warn, express warranty, and unreasonably dangerous product claims. Incorporated into the TRUMP AMERICA AI Act discussion draft.
bills.status_detail: Incorporated into TRUMP AMERICA AI Act discussion draft

bills.title: AI Content Provenance and Watermarking Standards
bills.summary: Would establish federal standards for AI content provenance, watermarking, and detection, requiring NIST-led guidelines and enabling FTC and state enforcement. Would require AI providers to support attaching provenance information on generated content. Incorporated into the TRUMP AMERICA AI Act discussion draft.
bills.status_detail: Incorporated into TRUMP AMERICA AI Act discussion draft

bills.bill_identifier: Preventing Woke AI in the Federal Government Act
bills.title: Federal Government AI Neutrality Requirements
bills.summary: Would codify the White House executive order, requiring agency heads to procure only LLMs that are truthful in responding to user prompts seeking factual information and that are neutral without ideological bias in responses. Incorporated into the TRUMP AMERICA AI Act discussion draft.
bills.status_detail: Incorporated into TRUMP AMERICA AI Act discussion draft

bills.bill_identifier: Third-Party Audits for Political Bias Provision
bills.title: AI High-Risk System Political Bias Audit Requirement
bills.summary: Would require third-party audits for high-risk AI systems to prevent discrimination based on political affiliation. Incorporated into the TRUMP AMERICA AI Act discussion draft.
bills.status_detail: Incorporated into TRUMP AMERICA AI Act discussion draft

bills.title: Digital Replica Unauthorized Use Liability
bills.summary: Would establish liability for the unauthorized use and distribution of digital replicas of individuals' voices or likenesses. Incorporated into the TRUMP AMERICA AI Act discussion draft.
bills.status_detail: Incorporated into TRUMP AMERICA AI Act discussion draft

bills.title: AI Public-Private Research Partnership Promotion
bills.summary: Would promote public-private AI research partnerships, standards development, and national lab testbeds. Incorporated into the TRUMP AMERICA AI Act discussion draft with amendments from original Cantwell version.
bills.status_detail: Incorporated into TRUMP AMERICA AI Act discussion draft

bills.title: National AI Research Resource Act
bills.summary: Would establish a national AI research resource to expand access to compute, data, and infrastructure. Incorporated into the TRUMP AMERICA AI Act discussion draft.
bills.status_detail: Incorporated into TRUMP AMERICA AI Act discussion draft

bills.title: Data Center Energy DOE Agreement Requirement
bills.summary: Would require data center operators to enter agreements with the Department of Energy to mitigate consumer rate impacts, or risk losing eligibility for federal incentives and assistance. Incorporated into the TRUMP AMERICA AI Act discussion draft with amendments from original Levin version.
bills.status_detail: Incorporated into TRUMP AMERICA AI Act discussion draft

bills.title: Copyright Holder AI Training Data Subpoena Authority
bills.summary: Would enable copyright holders to use administrative subpoenas to obtain information on whether their works were used to train AI models. Incorporated into the TRUMP AMERICA AI Act discussion draft.
bills.status_detail: Incorporated into TRUMP AMERICA AI Act discussion draft

bills.title: Pentagon AI Use Restrictions and Guardrails
bills.summary: Would establish guardrails on the Pentagon's use of AI by codifying existing Department of Defense policies. Would prohibit the use of AI for autonomous lethal decision-making, domestic mass surveillance, and the launch or detonation of nuclear weapons.
bills.status_detail: Introduced by Sen. Slotkin (D-MI)

bills.title: Vehicle Telematics Consumer Opt-In for Insurance
bills.summary: Would allow consumers to opt-in to the use of telematics to establish a driving record for insurance purposes. Insurers would be prohibited from requiring participation as a condition of obtaining or renewing coverage, penalizing consumers who decline, or increasing a premium in increments of less than six months from policy effective date.
bills.status_detail: Amended

bills.title: Connecticut Data Protection Act Amendment
bills.summary: CTDPA amendment approved by the General Law Committee on March 16. Includes technical changes to Delete Act-style data broker provisions, adjustments to the facial recognition technology limit for employee-only security purposes, removal of some algorithmic pricing disclosure requirements, and a new prohibition on using electronic pricing labels with personalized algorithmic pricing to increase the price for a specific consumer good in an in-person transaction.
bills.status_detail: Approved in committee by General Law Committee on March 16, 2026

bills.title: Illinois Comprehensive Privacy Bill
bills.summary: Illinois comprehensive privacy bill with hearings during the week of March 19-20.
bills.status_detail: In committee hearings week of March 19-20

bills.title: Illinois Comprehensive Privacy Bill (Companion)
bills.summary: Illinois comprehensive privacy bill with hearings scheduled during the week of March 19-20.
bills.status_detail: In committee hearings week of March 19-20

bills.title: Illinois Neural Data and BIPA Amendment
bills.summary: Illinois neural data and Biometric Information Privacy Act (BIPA) amendment bill with hearings during the week of March 19-20.
bills.status_detail: In committee hearings week of March 19-20

bills.title: Illinois Genetic Testing and Biomarker Data Privacy
bills.summary: Illinois genetic testing and biomarker data privacy bill with hearings scheduled during the week of March 19-20.
bills.status_detail: In committee hearings week of March 19-20

bills.title: Smart TV Automatic Content Recognition Data as Sensitive Data
bills.summary: Would amend the Kentucky Consumer Data Protection Act (KCDPA) to add 'automatic content recognition data' — data captured by a smart television or smart monitor — as a category of sensitive data.
bills.status_detail: Passed House on March 13, 2026

bills.title: Louisiana App Store Age Verification Children's Privacy Update
bills.summary: Would amend the Louisiana App Store Accountability Act (ASAA) to address constitutional concerns raised against the prior year's framework. Changes include adding parental consent obligations for accessing pre-installed apps and removing application exemptions.
bills.status_detail: Introduced by Rep. Beaullieu (R) on March 17, 2026

bills.title: Minnesota Age-Appropriate Design Code Children's Privacy Bill
bills.summary: An Age-Appropriate Digital Commerce (AADC)-style bill largely aligned with the Maryland model. Includes a 'best interests of children' fiduciary duty; requires companies to conduct Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs); restricts data management practices such as precise geolocation data processing; requires all default privacy settings to be at high privacy for children; and requires privacy information and terms of service in clear, age-appropriate language.
bills.status_detail: Introduced by Sen. Maye Quade (D) on March 18, 2026

bills.title: Minnesota Data Broker Annual Registration Requirement
bills.summary: Would require data brokers to register with the state annually and the attorney general to make registrants' information available on a public website.
bills.status_detail: Introduced by Rep. Elkins (D)

bills.title: Oklahoma Consumer Privacy Act
bills.summary: Oklahoma's comprehensive consumer privacy bill, closely adhering to the Virginia model. Passed its fourth reading and was sent to the governor on March 17, positioning Oklahoma to become the 20th U.S. state to enact a comprehensive consumer privacy law.
bills.status_detail: Passed fourth reading; sent to Governor on March 17, 2026

bills.title: Vermont Data Broker Registry and Consumer Deletion Rights Update
bills.summary: Would update Vermont's data broker registry law to require data brokers to comply with consumer deletion requests. The Secretary of State would study the feasibility of creating a California-style accessible deletion mechanism. Aligns definitions with comprehensive privacy laws and the California Delete Act. Effective date changed to January 1, 2027.
bills.status_detail: Substitute approved in committee; re-referred on March 17, 2026

bills.title: Vermont Neural Data Rights from Brain-Computer Interfaces
bills.summary: Would give consumers rights over the collection or recording of an individual's neural data gathered from a brain-computer interface.
bills.status_detail: Passed House on March 18, 2026

bills.title: Comprehensive Federal Consumer Privacy Bill (Lofgren)
bills.summary: A comprehensive privacy discussion draft released by Rep. Lofgren (D-CA) on March 19. Includes broad consumer rights (human review of impactful automated decisions, opt-in consent for using data for machine learning or AI algorithms, and retention decision rights); substantive data minimization obligations requiring a 'reasonable, articulated basis' for processing personal information; and the establishment of a new Digital Privacy Agency to issue regulations and enforce the bill.
bills.status_detail: Discussion draft released by Rep. Lofgren (D-CA) on March 19, 2026
